ignoreText: Create a free website with Framer, the website builder loved by startups, designers and agencies.
pages.why: Home page, decision 2 (faithful but simplified, looser tolerance 15 %: the tablet layout, 14 % shorter than Framer's, is the largest gap, desktop 0.4 %, phone 3.3 %): the gradient glows are CSS approximations, the 4 video layers are dropped and the FAQ has no answers. The ignored links and text are shared-chrome exceptions of T01 (Made in Framer, Coming Soon, the nav's /#about-us); /#about-us, the About Us section, and /#clients belong to T04's section.
